title: A closed or archived validation run leaves its slot reusable
description: Use a disposable gateway to verify cleanup preserves unpublished branch refs and immutable parking refs, records the commits, and returns slots to idle. Fresh prepare refuses to overwrite the retained branch; another ticket can prepare. Covers archive, close, named discard, cancelled and interactive runs, and stacked operator work. No operator runs or slots are used.

validation-slot-reuse.intent: Preserve unpublished branch and parking refs, return the slot to idle, refuse overwriting that branch, and let another ticket prepare.
